title: Endline banked cloze
instructions: Choose one word from the shared bank for each gap. Three words will not be used.

parts.prompt: Radio archive gap 1: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: Faded labels are difficult to read.
choice_rationales.B: A proposal cannot describe labels here.
choice_rationales.C: Catalogued does not describe their appearance.
choice_rationales.D: The tapes, not the labels, may be fragile.
choice_rationales.F: Distance does not affect readability here.
choice_rationales.G: An adverb cannot modify labels this way.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Faded” explains why the old labels were hard to read.

parts.prompt: Radio archive gap 2: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: Faded does not introduce an idea.
choice_rationales.C: Catalogued would require an object, not a gerund plan.
choice_rationales.E: Relieved is not a reporting verb here.
choice_rationales.G: Silently cannot serve as the main verb.
choice_rationales.H: Borrowed does not fit the meaning.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Proposed” introduces the plan to create an archive.

parts.prompt: Radio archive gap 3: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: Faded cannot describe the sorting action.
choice_rationales.B: The volunteers are processing recordings, not proposing each one.
choice_rationales.C: Catalogued means recorded and classified systematically.
choice_rationales.D: Fragile is not a past-tense action.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Catalogued” fits the systematic classification by subject.

parts.prompt: Radio archive gap 4: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: Fading concerns appearance, not risk of physical damage.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Fragile” explains why those tapes required protective cases.

parts.prompt: Radio archive gap 5: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: Faded does not describe the team's emotion.
choice_rationales.D: Fragile does not fit the emotional result.
choice_rationales.E: Relieved fits discovering that nothing was lost.
choice_rationales.F: Distant does not fit the cause.

parts.hint: Protected endline: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Relieved” describes the team's response to recovering the recording.
